SYJ-CanvasForge

SYJ-CanvasForge is a modern, browser-based PDF, image, and document editor built with React, TypeScript, Vite, PDF.js, pdf-lib, and Fabric.js. Edit PDFs, annotate documents, manipulate images, and process DOCX/TXT files entirely in your browser with a privacy-first, client-side architecture.
